title: HELIX Bridge: Workday HCM → Job Classification / EEO / Faculty Rank
module: HCM - Job Profile / Worker Additional Data
architecture_notes: Workday's Job Profile serves as the primary classification entity (equivalent to PeopleSoft's Job Code). Job Profiles belong to Job Families and Job Family Groups, which drive reporting hierarchies. For higher ed, Job Profiles need to accommodate both the standard EEO/SOC classification system AND the academic rank system (Professor → Associate → Assistant → Instructor → Lecturer). Faculty tenure status is typically tracked via a custom field or worker additional data, as Workday has no native tenure tracking.

source_objects.description: Job classification: title, family, level, EEO category, SOC code, FLSA status, pay rate type. Equivalent to PS_JOBCODE_TBL.
Grouping of related profiles. E.g., 'Faculty - STEM', 'IT - Infrastructure', 'Administrative - Finance'. Equivalent to PS_JOB_FAMILY_TBL.
Custom fields for academic-specific data: tenure status, academic rank, tenure date, sabbatical eligibility, tenure home department. Not native in Workday — requires configuration.
Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) and EEO job category mapping for federal reporting.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. The institution's job code.
Direct map. E.g., 'Professor of Computer Science'.
Map to IPEDS/EEO categories: 'Executive/Admin/Managerial', 'Faculty', 'Other Professional', 'Technical/Paraprofessional', 'Clerical/Secretarial', 'Skilled Crafts', 'Service/Maintenance'.
Standard Occupational Classification code. E.g., '25-1021' for CS professors.

attribute_mappings.source: Job Profile custom field or department CIP
attribute_mappings.transformation: Classification of Instructional Programs code. Relevant for faculty to link to academic discipline. E.g., '11.0101' for Computer Science.

Map: 'Distinguished Professor' → 'distinguished', 'Professor' → 'professor', 'Associate Professor' → 'associate', 'Assistant Professor' → 'assistant', 'Senior Lecturer' → 'senior_lecturer', 'Lecturer' → 'lecturer', 'Instructor' → 'instructor', 'Visiting Professor' → 'visiting', 'Professor Emeritus' → 'emeritus', 'Clinical Professor' → 'clinical', 'Research Professor' → 'research'.
Date tenure was granted. Null if not tenured. Cast to ISO 8601.

For IPEDS HR survey: 'Tenured', 'On Tenure Track', 'Not on Tenure Track/Multi-Year Contract', 'Not on Tenure Track/Annual Contract', 'Not on Tenure Track/Less Than Annual'. Cross-reference with FTE and function.
Map: true → 'exempt', false → 'non_exempt'. Faculty are typically exempt.

notes: Faculty classification in Workday is a known pain point. Workday has no native tenure tracking, academic rank system, or IPEDS faculty classification. Institutions must build these using custom fields (Worker Additional Data), custom objects, or calculated fields. The HELIX Bridge documents the recommended approach so institutions don't each reinvent it.
